# Citrus Neo

Citrus Neo uses a warm citrus palette with balanced light and dark modes and high-contrast typography. Headings, callouts, tags, tasks, tables and code blocks carry citrus accents, and OS-adaptive fonts are used for prose with monospace rendering for code.

![Citrus Neo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gthelding/obsidian-citrus-neo/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Citrus Neo"
    author: "Greg Helding"
    repo:   "gthelding/obsidian-citrus-neo"
    slug:   "citrus-neo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/citrus-neo"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/gthelding/obsidian-citrus-neo"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gthelding/obsidian-citrus-neo/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Use a warm citrus palette with balanced light and dark modes and high-contrast typography to create a focused, vibrant workspace. Style headings, callouts, tags, tasks, tables, and code blocks with citrus accents and OS-adaptive fonts for readable prose and monospace-friendly code rendering."
}
```
